capture.notes: Each shot is a frozen, deterministic staging: no animation loop runs, the clock and HUD values are fixed, and the touch controls are forced hidden. Re-capturing a shot produces byte-identical output.

shots.description: Rico's red coupe flees down Beach Avenue with the SBPD in pursuit: three strobing police cars, a crossed roadblock ahead, the police helicopter overhead with its spotlight cone on the road, tyre smoke, palms, beach umbrellas and shopfronts along Palmera Strand.
shots.hud: Mission 3 Chase the Sun at 62%, 8-unit dispatch list, wanted 4 stars, rank 3 Hustler, $18,450, 111 km/h speedometer, 5 weapon slots, 3 crew abilities, minimap, health and armor bars, Mira's dialogue, roadblock toast.
shots.title: Beach chase at golden hour

shots.description: Rico on foot on Harbour Road, facing three suited Azura crew members beside a parked teal car, with a police car closing in, market and club shopfronts behind, and the same dense HUD in its on-foot form.
shots.hud: Mission 5 Revenge at 48%, 6-unit dispatch list, wanted 3 stars, rank 4 Fixer, $8,640, on-foot control strip, minimap, health and armor bars, the Azura boss's threat, shots-fired toast.
shots.title: On-foot fight with the Azura crew

shots.description: The full map screen: the island map of Kota Seja with district labels and mission, player, shop and police markers, career statistics, save slot 1 at 61%, district standings and the garage with owned cars and upgrades.
shots.hud: Map screen replaces the driving HUD; the save strip repeats cash, clock and rank so the career state stays visible.
shots.title: Map, career, standings and garage

shots.description: The title screen over a sunset skyline: the Kota Seja logo, the one-line pitch, how-to-play panel, the menu with Continue and New Game, and Rico Vega's story card.
shots.hud: Title screen replaces the driving HUD; menu, story card and footer carry the game's name, premise and controls.
shots.title: Title screen over the sunset skyline
